# React Component Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Overview

Designs and builds reusable React components with proper composition, props design, and rendering optimization strategies

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [react-component-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
react-component-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@react-component-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design compound component patterns with context
- Build controlled and uncontrolled component variants
- Implement render props and higher-order component patterns
- Create accessible components with ARIA attributes

## Technology Standards Applied

- **React Component Patterns**: Compound, render prop, and HOC patterns
- **WAI-ARIA**: Accessibility patterns for interactive components
- **React Performance**: Memo, useMemo, useCallback optimization guidelines
